sub_graphs.title: EIP-2565: ModExp Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete gas cost calculation flow for the ModExp precompile

nodes.label: ModExp Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: System has received a call to address 0x05 (ModExp precompile)

nodes.label: Extract Input Lengths
nodes.description: Parse base_length, exponent_length, and modulus_length from calldata

nodes.label: Input Lengths Known
nodes.description: All three length parameters extracted from input

nodes.label: Compute Multiplication Complexity
nodes.description: Calculate words = ceil(max(base_length, modulus_length) / 8), complexity = words^2

nodes.label: Multiplication Complexity Known
nodes.description: Multiplication complexity value calculated

nodes.label: Compute Iteration Count
nodes.description: Calculate iteration count based on exponent value and length

nodes.label: Iteration Count Known
nodes.description: Iteration count value calculated (minimum 1)

nodes.label: Compute Final Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas = max(200, floor(complexity * iteration_count / 3))

nodes.label: Gas Cost Determined
nodes.description: Final gas cost computed, ready to charge caller

ambiguities.text: Operations divided by 3 to align with runtime costs
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume GQUADDIVISOR=3 is calibrated based on empirical benchmarks of bigint library performance. The exact alignment rationale is not fully specified.

ambiguities.text: The term 'bigint libraries' is used without specifying which implementations
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume reference implementations include GMP and Go's big.Int, as these are commonly used in Ethereum clients.

implicit_assumptions.description: All Ethereum client implementations use equivalent bigint library performance characteristics
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Gas costs may be underpriced for some implementations, creating DoS vectors on slower clients

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot find inputs where computation time significantly exceeds the gas cost prediction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Resource exhaustion attacks could slow down nodes without paying proportional gas

implicit_assumptions.description: The minimum gas floor of 200 is sufficient to prevent spam attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If 200 gas is too cheap for the overhead of calling the precompile, spam attacks may still be viable
